resources.string: We are very excited about your upcoming stay with us and looking forward to meeting you. We hope and believe that you will enjoy your stay with us. We have an exciting and active Rotary International Youth Exchange Program with students from around the world.

string.name: inbound_guide_welcome_section_1_item_2_title
string.description: InboundGuide welcome: what a fact is about.

resources.string: You will make friends from all over the world, in addition to making many Dutch friends in your school and Rotary.
One of the best years of your life

A wonderful experience in a new culture, with a new language but also with some rules to make sure that your stay will be both enjoyable for you and us alike. These rules are consistent with the International Rotary rules.

Please remember that under all circumstances you are an ambassador of Rotary and will have to behave accordingly. You will also be an ambassador of your country. Both roles will be with you at all times, and you will be regarded and judged as such throughout your exchange.
Live by these values during your exchange:

resources.string: Information about traveling to the Netherlands
You should obtain a changeable open return airline ticket. Your arrival airport is Amsterdam Airport Schiphol.
More arrival information will be provided closer to your departure date.

resources.string: There is no hiding it: Dutch is a very difficult language to learn. However, we do expect you to master the language, and within months after your arrival to be fluent in it.

resources.string: Tips for exploring the Netherlands and Europe
Travel is allowed with your host family, with Rotary club members, and on authorised school trips. These rules apply both inside the Netherlands and abroad.
Visits to family or friends abroad are not permitted.
One of your host families might suggest a holiday somewhere abroad. This is usually fine when you have written approval from your parents.
